product_overview: A Laravel-based e-commerce platform focused on baby and children products, providing a responsive Arabic (RTL) storefront, robust product management for admins, and a secure cart and checkout experience.
core_goals: Provide a fast, responsive Arabic (RTL) storefront for browsing and buying children's products
Enable reliable search, filtering and category browsing to help customers find products quickly
Support a resilient cart and checkout flow with authenticated order placement
Offer admin tools to manage products, categories, brands and orders securely
Ensure data protection and common web security best practices (CSRF, XSS, SQL injection protection, encrypted passwords)

features.name: Public Storefront API
features.description: Public endpoints to list products and browse by category for shoppers without requiring authentication.
user_flows: GET /shop -> Receive 200 with products list (paged) -> GET /shop/category/strollers -> Receive 200 with products filtered by 'strollers' category
GET /shop?per_page=0 -> Receive 400 Bad Request (invalid pagination) or validation error

features.name: Search & Product Browsing
features.description: Search and filter product listings (search, brand, price range, sort) to support discovery and faceted navigation.
user_flows: GET /shop?search=crib -> Receive 200 with matching products -> GET /shop?brand=brand-x&price_min=100&price_max=500 -> Receive 200 with filtered results -> GET /shop?sort=price_asc -> Receive 200 sorted results
GET /shop?search= (empty query) -> Receive 200 with default product list (no results filtered) or 400 if empty-query validation is enforced

features.name: Cart and Checkout
features.description: Add items to a cart (anonymous or authenticated session), then place an order via an authenticated endpoint to create a purchase.
user_flows: POST /cart/add with {product_id, quantity} -> Receive 200 and updated cart payload -> POST /place-an-order with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and {shipping_address, payment_method} -> Receive 201 with order_id and order summary
POST /cart/add with {product_id, quantity_exceeding_stock} -> Receive 409 Conflict with out-of-stock error
POST /place-an-order without Authorization header -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Admin Dashboard (Products & Orders)
features.description: Authenticated admin APIs for listing products and creating/updating product records and managing orders from the dashboard.
user_flows: POST /admin/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with admin JWT -> POST /admin/product/store with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> and product payload -> Receive 201 product created -> GET /admin/products with Authorization: Bearer <JWT> -> Receive 200 including the new product
POST /admin/product/store with missing required fields and valid Authorization -> Receive 422 Validation Error
GET /admin/products with expired or missing JWT -> Receive 401 Unauthorized
